title: Notification - Email My Case Status (EMCS) Service for all Police Stations of Gujarat for all cases of High Court of Gujarat
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
I. T. CELL
NOTIFICATION
(Ref. No. ITC/A4/2023)
Date: 7..h January, 2023
Email My Case Status (EMCS) Service for all Police Stations
of Gujarat for all cases of High Court of Gujarat
To facilitate easier and quicker access to latest information of
criminal cases for the Police Stations of the State, Hon'ble the Chief
Justice and Hon'ble Judges of the I. T. Committee of the High Court of
Gujarat, have been pleased to extend the Email My Case Status (EMCS)
Service of the High Court of Gujarat for all the Police Stations of the
State, to start transmission of automatic email updates of all the
criminal cases of the High Court of Gujarat to the respective Police
Stations as per the F. I. R. involved in the particular cases.
All the Police Stations will start receiving automatic email updates
whenever a case involving the FIR of the particular Police Station is
listed, adjourned or disposed of. These Police Stations will also get
order/ judgement passed in such cases as PDF attachment in the
EMCS email updates.
Soon, based on the EMCS Service platform, all the Police Stations
will also get an online dashboard of statistics of their pending cases and
information of next listing, disposal and order / judgement in their
cases. This online dashboard will serve as a complete portfolio of the
High Court cases relevant to be followed up by the respective Police
Station for effective and efficient tracking and compliance of Court
orders.
Roo
REGISTRAR GENERAL
ntoCopy forwarded for information and necessary action to:
1. The Additional Chief Secretary, Home Department,
Government of Gujarat
2. The Secretary, Legal Department, Government of Gujarat
3. Director General of Police, Gujarat State, Gandhinagar
4. State Crime Record Bureau (SCRB), Gandhinagar
5. All Police Stations of Gujarat (through email)
